qualifier: via collagen, thrombin, ADP and thromboxane agonist receptors
name: Platelet agonist receptor signaling, aggregation and degranulation
rationale: All members concern platelet activation and haemostasis; unlike confusables built on VWF variants, cytoskeletal remodeling or G12/13-Rho signaling, this theme holds the agonist-receptor routes (GPVI/collagen, PAR/thrombin, P2Y1/P2Y12, TP, prostacyclin) plus aggregation control and degranulation.

core: Lipid droplet dynamics and triglyceride storage
qualifier: droplet formation, fusion and lipophagic disassembly
name: Lipid droplet formation, fusion and lipophagy in triglyceride storage
rationale: Members cover the life cycle of lipid droplets and the retention of stored triglyceride (adipocyte storage module), distinguishing them from confusables on triglyceride synthesis, catabolism or fatty acid oxidation.

qualifier: mitotic disassembly and postmitotic reassembly
name: Nuclear pore complex disassembly and postmitotic reassembly
rationale: All three members concern NPC assembly/disassembly across mitosis, separating the theme from SUMOylation and nuclear lamina/envelope confusables that lack the pore complex itself.

core: MECP2 regulation of neuronal gene expression
qualifier: neuronal excitability, ion channel and receptor targets
name: MECP2 control of neuronal excitability and channel genes
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulation and loss-of-function steps plus the neuronal excitability readouts they control (channels, action potential, mGluR, GABA genes, touch and vision), whereas confusables add HDAC/NCoR repression and vocal or social behaviors.

core: Non-canonical Wnt planar cell polarity in convergent extension
qualifier: Wnt/Ca2+ branch
name: Non-canonical Wnt/PCP and Ca2+ signaling in convergent extension
rationale: Members share non-canonical Wnt signaling driving planar polarity and convergent extension; the Wnt/Ca2+ pathway members distinguish it from confusables on axial mesoderm, left-right asymmetry, Hedgehog or Wnt secretion.

qualifier: nitrosative stress, mitochondrial and neuronal death
name: Oxidative and nitrosative stress-driven mitochondrial and neuronal apoptosis
rationale: Members concern cell death and mitochondrial stress responses to ROS, hyperoxia and reactive nitrogen species, with neuronal apoptosis; confusables instead centre on H2O2 handling, HMOX1, ischemia or ferroptosis and lack the nitrosative and neuronal members.

qualifier: cleavage-polyadenylation plus decapping-driven 5'-3' decay
name: mRNA cleavage-polyadenylation and decapping-dependent 5' to 3' decay
rationale: Members cover 3'-end cleavage/polyadenylation and deadenylation-independent decapping/XRN decay; confusables are histone mRNA processing or deadenylation-dependent decay and stabilization.

qualifier: scavenger receptor ligand uptake
name: Scavenger receptor uptake and apoptotic cell efferocytosis
rationale: Members span recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells and scavenger receptor classes (including RAGE and hyaluronan turnover); confusables focus on foam cells, microglia or hyaluronan synthesis without the scavenger receptor classes.

qualifier: with vitamin B6 and serine metabolism
name: Lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases plus vitamin B6 and serine metabolism
rationale: Core members are lipoate-dependent PDH/OGDH/OADH/glycine-cleavage enzymes and their lysine/glycine substrates; the vitamin B6 and serine members are what confusables (TCA, BCAA, cofactor and amino acid catabolism) lack.

qualifier: visceral, including micturition and peristalsis
name: Visceral smooth muscle contraction and relaxation, including micturition
rationale: All members regulate smooth muscle tone; urinary tract contraction, micturition and peristalsis distinguish it from vascular, gastric and reproductive smooth muscle confusables.

qualifier: mtDNA transcription and mitochondrial mRNA stability
name: Mitochondrial genome transcription and mRNA stability control
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial transcription initiation/termination, mtDNA maintenance and mitochondrial RNA turnover (FASTK, decay), distinguishing them from confusables on mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA processing, translation or replication.

core: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and translation
qualifier: RNA-binding protein and small RNA-mediated silencing
name: mRNA stability, decay and small RNA-mediated silencing
rationale: Members are ARE-binding proteins, deadenylation/decay, miRNA/siRNA biogenesis and silencing and translational repression; confusables are mRNA export, transcription, translation/NMD or splicing.

qualifier: by RNA polymerases II and III
name: snRNA gene transcription by RNA polymerase II and III
rationale: Members cover snRNA gene transcription by Pol II and by Pol III type-3 promoters with Pol III elongation/termination; confusables are spliceosome function or Pol III type 1/2 (tRNA) initiation.

qualifier: gonad, germ cell, gonadotropin and placental development
name: Gonad and germ cell development, gonadotropins, and placentation
rationale: Members span gonad and reproductive tract development, germ cell specification, ovarian follicle/gonadotropin/activin signaling and trophoblast-placenta formation; placentation and gonadal endocrinology separate it from meiosis/gamete confusables and mammary/pancreas/prostate gland confusables.

core: Nucleic acid-sensing control of type I interferon
qualifier: endosomal TLR7/8/9 and ADAR RNA editing
name: Endosomal TLR7/8/9 and ADAR editing control of interferon
rationale: Members regulate self nucleic acid sensing (TLR7/8/9, IRF5, TREX1) and A-to-I editing restraining type I interferon; confusables are cytosolic RIG-I/cGAS antiviral responses or TLR3 defects lacking these.

qualifier: positive and negative tuning
name: B cell receptor signaling and its tuning
rationale: All members are BCR signaling and its activating or inhibitory regulation (CD22, leukocyte brake module), distinct from Fc receptor and CD28/TCR costimulation confusables.

qualifier: clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle recycling
name: Clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle recycling and neurotransmitter release control
rationale: Members regulate presynaptic transmitter release/uptake with synaptic vesicle endocytosis and clathrin uncoating, which confusables on presynaptic cytoskeleton, clustering or dendrites lack.

core: TRIF-dependent innate signaling to cell death
qualifier: necroptosis and TBK1/IKKe regulation of IRF3/7
name: TRIF-dependent necroptotic death and TBK1/IKKe regulation of IRF3/7
rationale: Members are TLR3/TRIF-driven programmed necrosis (incl. microbial modulation) and TBK1/IKKe activation of IRF3/7; confusables are caspase-8 extrinsic apoptosis, TRIF NF-kB arms or HSE deficiency.

core: Endothelial mechanotransduction and nitric oxide production
qualifier: PIEZO1 shear stress sensing and eNOS activation
name: Shear stress PIEZO1 mechanotransduction and endothelial eNOS activation
rationale: Members link PIEZO1/integrin flow and load sensing to eNOS trafficking, activation and NO synthesis; confusables have either NO-cGMP downstream effects, membrane pressure responses or SRF targets but not both halves.

qualifier: brown and beige adipocyte differentiation
name: Brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and fatty acid-fuelled thermogenesis
rationale: Members cover brown/beige fat differentiation, cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis and fatty acid cycling/transport; confusables are white adipogenesis, glycerol transport or negative thermogenic regulation.

core: Mitochondrial protein import and membrane organization
qualifier: cristae formation and outer membrane remodeling
name: Mitochondrial protein import, cristae formation and membrane remodeling
rationale: Members are mitochondrial protein import with cristae, outer membrane and fusion organization, versus confusables on mitochondrial protein degradation/processing or respiratory complex assembly.

qualifier: centromeric cohesion, condensation and spindle-kinetochore control
name: Mitotic sister chromatid cohesion, condensation and spindle-driven segregation
rationale: Members cover centromeric cohesion and its resolution, CENP-A centromere assembly, chromosome condensation and PLK1/Aurora spindle-checkpoint control; confusables are cohesin loading/looping or centrosome and cytokinesis events.

qualifier: from BCR and G beta-gamma to PLC, PI3K and PKC
name: BCR and G beta-gamma second-messenger signaling to PKC
rationale: Members share PLC/PI3K/BTK-generated second messengers and PKC activation downstream of BCR and Gbg; Gbg effectors and PKC/phorbol members distinguish it from Fc receptor and CD22-BCR regulation confusables.

qualifier: defective OGG1, MUTYH and NTHL1 variants
name: Defective OGG1, MUTYH and NTHL1 glycosylases in base excision repair
rationale: Seven of eight members are disease-variant defects of the oxidative-lesion glycosylases OGG1, MUTYH and NTHL1 (plus APEX1 handoff), distinguishing it from confusables on normal lesion recognition, AP-site processing or alkylation repair.

core: Reactive aldehyde detoxification and damage repair
qualifier: methylglyoxal glycation repair with vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactors
name: Methylglyoxal detoxification, glycation repair, and vitamin B6/molybdenum cofactors
rationale: Members combine methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and protein/DNA deglycation repair with cofactor (vitamin B6, molybdenum cofactor, sulfide oxidation) metabolism, which amino acid, lipoyl-dehydrogenase and selenium/sulfur confusables lack.
